evidence_binding.rule: coordinate value >=3 must cite a registered study of class >= that level (sha + evidence_class); internal replay never exceeds 2; adaptive-exploratory caps at 2 permanently

coordinates.T: theory/formalization; for THEOREM atoms tracks proof status itself
coordinates.P: strongest-parent subtraction; 3 requires faithful parent run at matched information/resources/checker access and subtracted; NOT_RUN stays 1
coordinates.M: measurement/construct validity; 3 requires hostile gaming families bounded or carried into claim ceiling
coordinates.C: causal evidence; 3 requires prospective knockout/ablation flipping outcome (E3)
coordinates.S: scaling/lifetime economics; full-lifecycle cost vector + frozen non-dominance rule
coordinates.A: autonomy/input audit; requires ledger coverage of the atom causal chain; 4 = clean-room
coordinates.E: external/ecological validity; non-toy worlds or independent scorer

CANNOT_CHECK_<reason>.requires: missing instrument named; resource shortage is not a reason

evidence_refs_rule: per coordinate with value >=1: null | {sha_or_pr, evidence_class, registered_question}
claim_ceiling_rules: ceiling = strongest claim compatible with current vector; exceeding it is a defect
finite certificates never lift to universal claims
value >=3 requires evidence sha + class; decreases allowed via amendment with cause
autonomy unaudited (A) gates any self-development/self-evolution sentence, not just the number

locks.in_flight: D17-D28 + #221 continuous jobs are mapped (D6), never duplicated
locks.non_finality: EXPLICITLY_NON_FINAL; supersede via append-only amendments, defending is a defect
